title: Princes of the Yen | The Hidden Power of Central Banks
summary: Michael Oswald's documentary, based on Richard Werner's book, argues that Japan's 1990s crash was engineered by the central bank and powerful interests. It focuses on the Bank of Japan's hidden influence over the economy.
why: HN commenters recommend it for a more cynical view of central bank power, though some caveat it as conspiracy-leaning.

quote.text: did a good job of illustrating the dangers of having such high powered unaccountable cabals
